jobs.title: Wetland Biologist
jobs.description:
Matrix New World Engineering, a part of True Environmental and its partner firms, have united their strengths to establish the nation's premier environmental and engineering services consulting firm. This powerhouse organization offers an extensive range of services aimed at revolutionizing the built environment and preserving the natural one. Its diverse expertise encompasses environmental remediation, urban planning, engineering iconic coastal and marine structures, developing sustainable energy sources, and pioneering resource extraction methods. Explore further at www.MWNE.com and True-Environmental.com to discover the full scope of our capabilities.

**Matrix New World** is seeking an experienced **Wetland Biologist** who desires a challenging career to join our well-established team of Environmental Scientists, GIS Analysts, and Land Surveying professionals to participate in projects throughout the Gulf Coast.  
  
The successful candidate will be a dynamic and technologically savvy individual with the vision and drive to apply state-of-the-art technologies and methodologies to a wide range of biological, ecological, land surveying, and geospatial projects. The biologist will possess the experience to serve a field team lead and will be responsible for collecting all required field data for the preparation of technical reports and deliverables for both public and private clients. The successful candidate will also use GIS (ArcGIS Pro) and mobile data collection tools (ArcGIS Field Maps, Survey123, sub-meter GPS) to collect, review, and QA/QC field data, and will prepare basic maps and figures for wetland delineation reports and permit submittals.

### **Minimum Requirements**

* Minimum 1-2 years of field experience
* Must be a self-starter and with the ability to work independently if required.
* Strong team-player skills.
* Must possess a valid driver’s license with a clean driving record.
* Ability and willingness to travel 50-60% of the time (including working outdoors in adverse weather conditions)
* Must pass a pre-employment drug test and will be subject to random drug & alcohol testing.
* Follow all safety and security procedures.
* Represent Matrix New World whilst interfacing with public and private sector clients and the general public.
* Familiar with GPS units and GPS data collection
* Current FAA Part 107 Drone Pilot license or the ability to obtain one within 6 months of employment
* 1-2 years of professional GIS experience
* Working knowledge of ArcGIS Pro and core geoprocessing tools
* Experience with ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Portal, and Esri field applications (Survey123, Field Maps, etc.) preferred

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong attention to detail and data QA/QC habits
* Ability to work as part of a multi-disciplinary team with limited direction and oversight
* Ability to manage tight/shifting deadlines and multiple projects concurrently
* Excellent technical writing and oral communication skills
* Attention to detail along with strong organizational skills
* Strong problem-solving abilities and aptitude
* Positive attitude; good interpersonal skills
* Insures the safety of all crew members, clients, and the public

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: WFH Remote Drone Supervisor
jobs.description:
Are you an FAA Part 107 Certified drone pilot looking to earn money remotely, all from the comfort of your home?

Fliteworks is expanding our team of remote drone supervisors to support our growing nationwide flight operations. We're looking for dependable pilots interested in full-time, part-time, or weekend opportunities.

We need pilots to log on when scheduled to fly and oversee its preflight checklist and flight. The process is very standardized, and the role of the pilot is to monitor the flight and step in if needed.

**Scheduling & Availability**

We offer flexible scheduling and work with pilots to coordinate missions based on their availability and our operational needs. We're currently looking for pilots interested in the following schedules:

* **Full-Time Availability:** Consistent weekday availability to support daily flight operations and multiple scheduled missions.
* **Part-Time Availability:** Flexible weekday availability for pilots looking to supplement their existing schedules.
* **Weekend Availability:** Pilots available on Saturday and Sunday to provide consistent weekend coverage. This can be alternating weekends.

Pilots can supervise individual missions lasting around 30 minutes or work multiple consecutive missions, depending on availability and operational demand.

**Please Note:** Flight operations are weather-dependent and subject to site conditions, equipment availability, and operational requirements. Scheduled missions may be delayed, rescheduled, or canceled, sometimes with limited advance notice. Pilots are compensated based on the time spent supervising missions. Actual working hours may vary from week to week.

**Responsibilities:**

* Work with us to schedule shifts, and log-in on time for the shifts you’ve scheduled.
* Look at video feeds, weather forecasts, and dashboard readouts to complete a preflight checklist and make sure the conditions are safe for the drone to fly.
* Monitor live video feed and dashboard while the drone is in flight to make sure it is flying safely.
* If necessary, control the drone or abort the mission using the dashboard.

**Job Requirements:**

* FAA Part 107 Certification
* Basic knowledge of drone operations and FAA regulations.
* Ability to assess weather conditions, airspace restrictions, and potential flight hazards
* Familiarity with drone flight systems and remote monitoring software
* A reliable internet connection
* A desktop or laptop computer
* A phone to reach you in emergencies

**Company Overview:**

Fliteworks is building a nationwide network of unmanned aircraft to keep watch over critical infrastructure, from highways, to pipelines, to power plants. We have FAA approval to deploy drones that don’t require on-site supervision, and we’re using this to bring visibility to even the most remote assets. Our mission is to transform infrastructure monitoring from a time-consuming, backlogged task into a continuous, mass-scale resource that prevents disasters and enables our society to build more than ever before.

Job Type: Contract

Pay: From $20.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Application Question(s):

* What is your availability (full-time, part-time, or weekends)?

License/Certification:

* FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certification (Required)

Work Location: Remote
